### Why Frankincense and Myrrh?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-december-23-2020.html
Passage: Exodus 30:34-37
Points:
- The holy incense in Exodus was sacred perfume reserved exclusively for the worship of God.
- Frankincense signifies Christ's sinless deity, spiritual beauty, and intercession for believers.
- The inclusion of myrrh with the gifts of the Wise Men pointed forward to Jesus' sacrificial death and burial.
- Truly wise followers respond to Christ's divine identity and sacrifice through worship, generosity, and service.
